key.name: glass-mode
key.description: Auto uses liquid glass when available and falls back to frosted; liquid forces the shader; frosted uses blur only; off disables glass.

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the glass tint over the blurred backdrop.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: Darkening tint applied to the blurred backdrop.

key.name: animations
key.description: Whether Sift fades and scales in and out.

key.name: max-results
key.description: Largest number of result rows kept for the search view; extras scroll.

key.name: search-height
key.description: Height in logical pixels (it scales with the display) of the expanded search panel; clamped to fit the monitor.

key.name: grid-labels
key.description: Whether app names appear under icons in the app grid.

key.name: disable-overview
key.description: When on, Super and Super+A open Sift and every other GNOME overview trigger (Activities, the hot corner, swipe and the login overview) does nothing. When off, GNOME's overview works normally.

key.name: sift-search-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Sift search. When unset with the GNOME overview disabled, Super is the default; a recorded shortcut replaces it. Sift never changes GNOME's own shortcuts.

key.name: sift-apps-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Sift's app grid. When unset with the GNOME overview disabled, Super+A is the default; a recorded shortcut replaces it. Sift never changes GNOME's own shortcuts.
